task: Unchanged R8 independent-future known-model risk task; same information and costs for all filters.
purpose: Validate reusable sufficient-state implementation and measure full execution cost, without asserting a spiking advantage.
training: None. Preserve all R8 fits and their complete reported training cost; optimize ordinary exact control identically.

quality.scope: Implementation validation on existing R8 confirmation seeds, not a new blind scientific test.
quality.recovery: Compare uninterrupted and JSON-recovered streams with identical update partitions; require exact serialized state and risk equality.
quality.chunking: Compare block vs one-observation ingestion within 1e-12; floating-point order is not claimed bit-identical.

benchmark.order: Alternate implementation order by round; use both CPU and wall clocks, record every sample.
benchmark.scope: Shared CPU host; no exclusive-host latency or hardware energy claim.

acceptance.implementation: All parity, actions, recovery and malformed-state checks pass.
acceptance.speed: Report per workload; do not hide any regression in one-shot or scalar operation.
acceptance.mechanism: A matching ordinary exact filter is a failed independent-necessity gate, even when generic streaming is faster.
